Sprinting, sliding, or firing increases the Overcharge Capacitor based on the action performed:
• Sliding grants 10% progress
• Sprinting for 0.25 seconds grants 20% progress per second 
• Shooting for 0.267 seconds grants 20% progress per second

Overcharge Capacitor linearly? grants the following benefits based on progress:
• ? Range
• ? Reload Speed

At above 40% charge, kills cause enemies to explode for <pve 95 /> <pvp [76] /> damage and apply <arc/>Blind for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius. At 100% charge, the explosions deal <pve 189 /> <pvp [?] /> damage and <arc/>Blind for 10 seconds in an 8 meter radius.

Overcharge Capacitor decays at a rate of 33% per second after 1.1 seconds of not being built. Performing a manual reload resets your charge to 0%.
